thread:
jess: quick sync on playground controls — users think 'Pause' means resume later. we don't checkpoint partial output.
mike: agree. infra keeps session for ~10s but no true resume. need clearer labels.
sophia: suggestion: 'Pause updates' (soft) and 'Stop & release' (hard). tooltip: 'Pauses UI updates for 10s; generation may continue server-side.'
anya: mobile needs shorter: 'Pause updates' / 'Stop & free'. add tiny helper under the button for 1-line explanation.
ux-bot: a11y: add aria-pressed and state text e.g., 'Pause updates (active)'. Keyboard shortcuts: Esc = soft pause, Shift+Esc = hard stop. aria-live for token counter but debounce to 1s.
mike: backend: we can emit token deltas with stream chunks and throttle to 1s. fine.
sophia: token counter: show compact live number + chevron to expand breakdown (Sent | Response | Session). keep default compact.
anya: prompt library: add 'Favorites' shelf, drag-to-insert, and quick-insert hover with 2-line preview. keyboard: arrow nav + typeahead + Enter to insert.
jess: edge case: inserting prompt during stream should warn: 'Inserting this prompt will stop the current response. Insert anyway?' primary 'Insert and stop' secondary 'Cancel'.
ux-bot: a11y checklist: contrast >=4.5:1 for token badges, visible focus rings, announce toasts role=alert, debounce aria-live.
jess: actions: 1) update Figma labels & tooltip, 2) prototype compact token counter, 3) prompt library favorites + quick-insert, 4) add keyboard & a11y checklist to PR. thanks all :thumbsup:
